Accounting policies and approval matrix · in force for FY2026
Demonstration document. Every name and figure is invented.
Vendor setup: new vendors and changes to a vendor’s bank account are entered by Accounts Payable and approved by the
Controller in the vendor master before the first payment; a W-9 is required.
Payment approval: Accounts Payable prepares each payment run in the bank portal and the Controller approves it; the preparer of a
Invoice approval: the project manager approves each vendor invoice against the job’s commitment before it is paid.
Pay application approval: each pay application is approved by the job’s project manager and by the Controller before it is sent to the
Cash receipts: posted within one business day of the deposit and agreed to the bank.
Rate changes: entered only from a personnel action form signed by the Chief Financial Officer (field and estimating) or the President
Payroll release: the Controller reviews the payroll register against the prior payroll and approves it before release.
Journal entry review: manual journal entries over the threshold are reviewed and initialed by a second person before posting: the
Controller for others’ entries and the Chief Financial Officer for the Controller’s own.
Bank reconciliation due: 15 days after month end
Bank reconciliation review: prepared by the Project Accountant and reviewed, signed and dated by the Controller.
User access: the Controller assigns roles; no one may both set up vendors and approve payments, both edit the payroll master and
process payroll, or both post and approve journal entries.
